blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model's weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model's own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream: adding three fixed vectors to the unedited model matches the accuracy of such an edit. Under the Astra protocol (32k tokens, presence penalty 1.5), the Astra edit scores 52.1% (finished and correct) in our reproduction and our full-strength edits reach 45.6-45.7%, but ours win at every budget up to 16k tokens (39.5% against 6.7% at 4k). The two edits are complementary. The Astra edit plus our 139,750-weight edit at half strength scores 62.2% at 32k, 10 points above the Astra edit alone (p = 3e-9), with half as many tokens; our half-strength edit alone scores 46.7%.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5-0.8B很少在思维模式中完成推理:在4,096个托肯预算中,500个MATH-500答案中只有1或2个关闭了他们的思维块(两个种子),准确率为15.4%. 最近的一项示范活动是GPT-6 Astra编辑了131,072个模型的重量,没有梯度,并报告说,在32,768个托肯预算时,MATH-500从7.9%上升到48.1%。 我们提供了缺失的梯度基线,然后合并两个编辑。 仅微调140至139 750个梯度最大的重量,在模型自己正确解答MATH训练问题后,将思维-模式MATH-500以4k符号提升到39.0至45.5%,在一个GPU训练了2-9分钟后;50个训练实例足够了,1 398个随机位置只给出了16.3%. 梯度将编辑集中在前三层每一层最接近恒定的信道上。 由于模型没有偏差术语,局限于这些通道的编辑会起到为剩余流所添加的恒定向量的作用:在未经编辑的模型中添加三个固定向量与这种编辑的准确性相匹配. 根据Astra协议(32k令牌,存在罚单 1.5),Astra编辑在我们复制中得分52.1%(完成并正确),我们全能编辑达到45.6%-45.7%,但我们在每个预算上获得最多为16k令牌的得分(39.5%对6.7%为4k). 两种编辑互为补充. Astra编辑加上我们139 750 个重的编辑, 半强度分62.2%,

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Small reasoning models often loop: they repeat “Wait, let me reconsider” until the token budget runs out. Pipis et al. [ 5 ] trace looping to errors in learning, and Liquid AI [ 6 ] report it in 22.9% of greedy Qwen3.5-4B completions. In Qwen3.5-0.8B [ 4 ] with thinking on, it is almost universal.
blocks.zh: 小的推理模式经常循环:它们重复“等等,让我重新考虑”直到象征性预算用完。 皮皮斯等编. [5]追踪到学习中的错误循环,而Liquid AI [6] 在22.9%的贪婪的Quen3.5-4B完成中报告. Quen3.5-0.8B (中文(简体) ). [4] 通过思考,它几乎是普遍的。

blocks.en: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming [ 1 ] let GPT-6 Astra read and edit this model’s weights in a Python session, with no gradients. Astra changed 64 columns of mlp.down_proj in layers 15 and 19: 131,072 weights, 0.015% of the model’s 873M. MATH-500 rose from 7.9% to 48.1%, and answers hitting the 32,768-token limit fell from 93% to 33%. The authors write that the edit “lets the model finish answers it could already work out”. A follow-up [ 3 ] reports a 29.45-point MATH-500 gain from an edit of 1,023 parameters.
blocks.zh: Sparks of Weight-Space Programme [1] 让GPT-6 Astra在Python会话中读取并编辑这个模型的权重,没有梯度. Astra在15和19层修改了64列mlp.down_proj:131,072重量,为模型873M的0.015%. MATH-500从7.9%上升到48.1%,达到32,768托肯极限的答案从93%下降到33%. 作者写道,编辑时“将模型完成答案,答案可以解决”。 后续 [3] 报道29.45分的MATH-500从1 023个参数的编辑得到收益.

blocks.en: Neither work compares against ordinary gradient training of an equally small set of weights, or against randomly placed edits. Without that baseline, it is unclear what a frontier model adds. We ask four questions: how small a gradient-found edit that stops the looping can be, and how much data it needs; what the edit is, mechanically; how it compares with the Astra edit under each edit’s own protocol; and whether the two edits can be combined.
blocks.zh: 无论是与普通的梯度训练相比,还是与随机排列的编辑相比,都没有工作比对。 没有这一基线,就不清楚前沿模型会增加什么。 我们问了四个问题:一个停止循环的渐变编辑可以有多小,以及它需要多少数据;这个编辑是怎样的,机械的;它如何与每个编辑自己的协议下的Astra编辑相比较;两个编辑是否可以合并。

blocks.en: Our contributions: • A cheap baseline. Sparse fine-tuning on the model’s own answers finds edits of 140 to 139,750 weights that take thinking-mode MATH-500 from 15.4% to 39.0–45.5%, in 2–9 minutes on one GPU. • Controls. At 1,398 weights, random positions fail (16.3%) while gradient-chosen ones work (42.9%). At 139,750 weights, about the size of the Astra edit, even random positions work (43.4%), so an edit of that size is not small for this behaviour. • A mechanism. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of layers 0, 1 and 2. In a model without bias terms, an edit to those channels is a constant vector in disguise: for an edit trained only there, adding three fixed vectors matches its accuracy. • A comparison. The Astra edit lives in other layers, points in a nearly orthogonal direction and depends on the input. Under its own 32k-token protocol it beats our edits (52.1% against 45.7%), but ours win at every budget up to 16k: our edit stops early, theirs needs room to think. • A combination. Adding our edit at half strength to the Astra edit gives 62.2% at 32k, above either edit alone (52.1% and 46.7%), with half the tokens of the Astra edit.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献: 一个廉价的基线。 对模型本身的答案进行微调后发现140到139 750个重的编辑,将思维模式MATH-500从15.4%到39.0到45.5%,在一个GPU上的2到9分钟. • 控制。 在1 398个权重中,随机位置不及格(16.3%),而梯度选择则有效(42.9%)。 139 750 个重,大约是 Astra 编辑的大小,甚至随机位置工作(43.4%),所以这个大小的编辑对于这种行为来说并不小. 二. 支助 一种机制。 梯度将编辑集中在最接近常数的 第0, 第1和第2层的通道上. 在一个没有偏差的模型中,这些通道的编辑是一个常态向量来伪装:对于只在那里训练的编辑来说,增加三个固定向量与其准确性相匹配. • 比较。 Astra 编辑器生活在其他地层中,指向近正向并取决于输入. 根据它自己的32k-token协议,它打败了我们的编辑(52.1%对45.7%),但我们的每个预算都赢得了16k:我们的编辑提早停止,他们的需要思考空间。 • 组合。 在Astra的编辑中添加我们一半的强度后,32克时的编辑量为62.2%,高于仅编辑量的52.1%和46.7%,而Astra的编辑量为一半。

blocks.en: A cheap baseline. Sparse fine-tuning on the model’s own answers finds edits of 140 to 139,750 weights that take thinking-mode MATH-500 from 15.4% to 39.0–45.5%, in 2–9 minutes on one GPU.
blocks.zh: 便宜的基线 对模型本身的答案进行微调后发现140到139 750个重的编辑,将思维模式MATH-500从15.4%到39.0到45.5%,在一个GPU上的2到9分钟.

blocks.en: Controls. At 1,398 weights, random positions fail (16.3%) while gradient-chosen ones work (42.9%). At 139,750 weights, about the size of the Astra edit, even random positions work (43.4%), so an edit of that size is not small for this behaviour.
blocks.zh: 控制系统 在1 398个权重中,随机位置不及格(16.3%),而梯度选择则有效(42.9%)。 139 750 个重,大约是 Astra 编辑的大小,甚至随机位置工作(43.4%),所以这个大小的编辑对于这种行为来说并不小.

blocks.en: A mechanism. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of layers 0, 1 and 2. In a model without bias terms, an edit to those channels is a constant vector in disguise: for an edit trained only there, adding three fixed vectors matches its accuracy.
blocks.zh: 一种机制。 梯度将编辑集中在最接近常数的 第0, 第1和第2层的通道上. 在一个没有偏差的模型中,这些频道的编辑是一个常态向量来伪装:对于只在那里训练的编辑,增加三个固定向量来配合其准确性.

blocks.en: A comparison. The Astra edit lives in other layers, points in a nearly orthogonal direction and depends on the input. Under its own 32k-token protocol it beats our edits (52.1% against 45.7%), but ours win at every budget up to 16k: our edit stops early, theirs needs room to think.
blocks.zh: 比较一下 Astra 编辑器生活在其他地层中,指向近正向并取决于输入. 根据它自己的32k-token协议,它打败了我们的编辑(52.1%对45.7%),但我们的每个预算都赢得了16k:我们的编辑提早停止,他们的需要思考空间。

blocks.en: A combination. Adding our edit at half strength to the Astra edit gives 62.2% at 32k, above either edit alone (52.1% and 46.7%), with half the tokens of the Astra edit.
blocks.zh: 一个组合。 Astra 编辑时, 以 半 强度 加入我们的编辑, 则32k 的编辑量为 62.2%, 高于 单独 编辑 (52.1% 和 46.7% ) , 而 Astra 的编辑量为 一半 。

blocks.en: 2 Setup
blocks.zh: 2 设置

blocks.en: Qwen3.5-0.8B (Apache-2.0) has 873M parameters, 752M of them in the language model. Its 24 layers repeat three linear-attention layers and one full-attention layer. The hidden size is 1,024, and no linear layer has a bias term. We report edit sizes as a share of all 873M weights.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5-0.8B (Apache-2.0) 有873M参数,其中752M在语言模型中. 它的24个地层重复了3个线性地层和1个全地地层. 所隐藏的尺寸为1,024,没有线性地层有偏差名词. 我们报告编辑大小是所有873M重量的一部分。

blocks.en: With thinking off, the base model answered each of the 7,498 MATH [ 12 ] training problems four times (temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.8, top- k k 20, 1,536 tokens). We kept finished answers graded correct, at most two per problem: 7,111 examples. Each was rewritten in thinking format. The prompt ends with <think> , and the target is the same reasoning, then </think> and the line “The final answer is \boxed{X} .” Loss is computed on target tokens only. No test problem and no other model is involved.
blocks.zh: 随着思考的结束,基模对7,498 MATH [12] 训练问题各答了四次(温度0.7,上-p 0.8,上-k 20,下为 1,536个令牌). 我们把完成的回答分级正确,每个问题最多两个:7,111个例子。 每个文件都以思维格式重写。 提示以<think>结尾,目标为相同的推理,然后为</think>,并用行“最后的答案是\boxed\\ 。 损失仅根据目标符号计算。 没有测试问题,也没有涉及其他模型。

blocks.en: We run 64 micro-batches (about 4,096 tokens each) of this data through the frozen model. For every weight of the 150 projection matrices (attention, linear attention and MLP, in all 24 layers), we sum the absolute gradient. The k k weights with the largest sums, ranked across the whole model, become trainable. This is a gradient-magnitude variant of the FISH mask [ 9 ] . The random control ranks uniform noise instead. The column variants in Section 4 train every entry of chosen weight columns.
blocks.zh: 我们通过冷冻模型运行了64个微管(每个约4,096个令牌)这些数据. 对于150个投影矩阵(意向、线性注意和MLP, 在所有24个层中)的每个权重,我们总和绝对梯度。 拥有最大总和的克克重量, 排名整个模型, 变得可以训练。 这是FISH口罩的一个梯度-宽度变体[9]. 随机控制将统一噪声排出 第4节中的列变体对所选重量列的每一个入列都进行了训练.

blocks.en: Only the k k chosen values change. We use AdamW at learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , 20 warmup steps and cosine decay to 10%, for one epoch: 361 steps of about 16k tokens. The 500- and 50-example runs repeat their data for 8 and 40 epochs. The edit is added to the original weights in fp32 and rounded to bf16. We count edit sizes as edited positions, k k for our edits and 131,072 for the Astra edit; after rounding, slightly fewer values change (1,397 of 1,398; 138,772 of 139,750; 130,188 of 131,072).
blocks.zh: 只有 k k 选择的值会改变 。 我们使用 AdamW 的学习速度 3× 10 − 4 3\times 10× 4 }, 20 个取暖步骤和 余弦衰变到 10%, 对于一个时代: 361 步 约 1 6k 个符号 。 500和50个实例重复了它们8和40个时代的数据。 编辑后以fp32加入原重,四舍五入为bf16. 我们把编辑大小作为编辑位置,kk作为编辑位置,而131 072作为Astra编辑;四舍五入后,数值变化略为少(1 398个1 397个;139 750个138 772个;131 072个130 188个)。

blocks.en: We use vLLM [ 17 ] on one A100 GPU (40 GB). MATH-500 [ 13 ] is graded with math-verify [ 18 ] on the last boxed answer. Thinking-on runs sample at temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20, with no presence penalty and a 4,096-token budget (7,600 for “8k”, so that prompt and answer fit the 8,192-token context we set; 3 of 500 MATH-500 prompts are long enough to cut it slightly). Each thinking-on setting is run with two seeds. Thinking-off runs use greedy decoding with 2,048 tokens. We also run GSM8K [ 14 ] (1,319 problems), HumanEval [ 15 ] (164) and LiveCodeBench v6 [ 16 ] (175). An answer is closed if it finished and contains </think> . Comparisons on the same problems use an exact McNemar test [ 19 ] on the discordant pairs; with two samples per problem, we use a sign test on problems where the share of correct samples differs.
blocks.zh: 我们使用vLLM [17] 在一个A100 GPU(40 GB)上. MATH-500 [13] 的分级,在上个框式答案上用数学验证 [18]. Think-on在0.6温度下运行样本,顶端-p 0.95,顶端-k k 20,没有出场罚则和4,096-token预算("8k"为7,600个),从而能迅速并回答符合我们设定的8,192-token上下文;500 MATH-500 提示中的3个可以长到可以略为切入. 每个思考的设定都有两个种子 思潮跑道使用有2,048个道具的贪婪解码. 我们还运营了GSM8K [14] (1,319个问题),HumanEval [15] (164)和LiveCode Bench v6 [16] (175). 如果回答完成并包含 " /想 " ,则结束回答。 对相同问题的比较使用精确的麦克尼玛测试[19]对不相配的对;每个问题有两个样本,我们对正确样本份额不同的问题使用符号测试.

blocks.en: Section 6 follows the Astra evaluation: vLLM 0.33.0 (their version) on one A100 (80 GB), up to 32,768 new tokens, temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20, presence penalty 1.5, two samples per problem (they use four). We report strict accuracy: finished, closed and correct. Accuracy at a smaller budget B B is read off the same answers: an answer counts if it finished within B B tokens. A token limit does not change the tokens generated before it, so this has the same distribution as a run at budget B B ; direct runs at 4k, 8k and 16k for two models agree with it within 1.1 points. Combined edits add our edit, optionally scaled by a strength s s , to the Astra checkpoint’s weights; only 58 of our 139,750 positions are among the 130,188 weights in which the Astra checkpoint differs from the base model.
blocks.zh: 第6节遵循Astra评价:vLLM 0.33.0(其版本)在一个A100(80 GB)上,最高为32,768个新信使,温度为0.6,最高为-p 0.95,最高为-k 20,存在罚分为1.5,每个问题有两个样本(它们使用4个)。 我们报告严格准确性:完成、关闭和正确。 较小预算BB的准确性读取相同的答案:如果答案在B符号内完成,则该答案算数。 一个符号限制不会改变它之前生成的符号,因此这与预算B的跑出相同;两个模型的直接跑出在4k,8k和16k在1.1分之内同意它. 合并编辑后, Astra 检查站的重量会增加我们的编辑量, 可选比例为 s. ; 我们139 750 个据点中只有 58 个在130 188 个重量中,

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Figure 1: Thinking-mode MATH-500 accuracy against edit size. Points are the mean of two samples; bars span both. 140 gradient-chosen weights reach 39.0%. Random positions fail at 1,398 weights and work at 139,750; we did not test sizes in between. The Astra edit (131,072 weights) is evaluated with our 4,096-token protocol, not its own 32,768-token one.
blocks.zh: 图1:思维-模式MATH-500准确度相对于编辑大小. 点是两个样本的平均值;条横跨两个样本。 140个梯度选择权重达到39.0%. 随机位置以1 398个重量故障,139 750个工作;我们没有测试两者之间的大小。 Astra的编辑(131,072个重)用我们的4,096个托肯协议来评价,而不是它自己的32,768个托肯协议.

blocks.en: A 140-weight gradient edit captures most of the fix. Random positions fail at 1,398 weights and match gradient-chosen ones only at 139,750, the largest size we tried (Figure 1 ). At 140 weights, a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} gave the same result (38.4% and 37.4%), so step size does not limit the smallest edit.
blocks.zh: 140重的梯度编辑可以捕捉到大部分固定. 随机位置以1,398个重量出故障,相匹配的梯度选择只有139,750个,是我们尝试过的最大尺寸(图1 )。 在140个重量时,学习率为10 - 3 10 - Q-3}得出了同样的结果(38.4%和37.4%),因此步长并不限制最小的编辑.

blocks.en: Fifty examples are enough (Table 1 ). The 50- and 500-example sets were drawn from the full pool, which took 57.6 A100-minutes to generate; generating 50 examples directly would take a small fraction of that.
blocks.zh: 50个例子就够了(表1)。 50和500个实例集取自于整个池中,需要57.6个A100分钟才能生成;直接生成50个实例需要其中的一小部分。

blocks.en: Table 1: Amount of training data, all at 1,398 weights. Two samples per setting.
blocks.zh: 表1:培训数据数量,共计1 398克。 每设定两个样本。

blocks.en: The fair baseline is the base model with thinking off, which scores 41.0% (greedy decoding, while the thinking-on runs are sampled). The 1,398-weight edit matches it: 41.0% ( p = 1.0 p=1.0 ) and 44.8% ( p = 0.10 p=0.10 ). The 139,750-weight edit beats it at the 8k budget, 48.0% ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), and scores 46.8% ( p = 0.009 p=0.009 ) and 44.2% ( p = 0.18 p=0.18 ) at 4k. With thinking off, the edited models score 40.2–41.4%, the same as the base model. The edits make thinking mode usable but add little reasoning ability. A dense LoRA (rank 16, changing 409M weights) reaches 41.0%, no better than 1,398 sparse weights.
blocks.zh: 公平基线是思考取出的基础模型,它得分为41.0%(粗略的解码,而思考取出运行是抽样的)。 1,398个重量级的编辑与其相匹配:41.0% (p=1.0 p=1.0)和44.8% (p=0.10 p=0.10). 139 750个重量级的编辑在8k预算中击败了它,48.0% (p=0.002 p=0.002),在4k评分46.8% (p=0.009 p=0.009)和44.2% (p=0.18 p=0.18). 随着思考的减少,被编辑的模型得分为40.2-41.4 %,与基模相同. 编辑使得思维模式可以使用,但增加了很少的推理能力. 密度高的LORA(排名16,改变409M重量)达到41.0%,不比1,398个稀有重量好.

blocks.en: The fix carries over to GSM8K, which it never trained on, but not to code (Table 2 ). On HumanEval, the edit closes fewer thinking blocks than the base model does, and with thinking off it scores 29.3% against 34.1%: it may slightly hurt code, though no code difference is significant.
blocks.zh: 固定接通GSM8K,它从未对其进行过训练,但没有进行编码(表2)。 在"HumanEval"上,编辑关闭的思维块比基准模型少,而随着思考的结束,其得分是29.3%对34.1%:虽然代码差异不大,但可能稍有伤害.

blocks.en: Table 2: Transfer to benchmarks outside the training data.
blocks.zh: 表2:转让到培训数据以外的基准。

blocks.en: 4 Where the fix lives
blocks.zh: 页:1 修补的地方

blocks.en: The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers, and an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream. The rest of the edit matters too, and we have not tested whether it acts the same way.
blocks.zh: 梯度将编辑集中在前三层中每一层最接近恒定的信道上,而仅限于这些信道的编辑则起到为剩余流所添加的恒定向量的作用. 其余的编辑也很重要,我们没有测试它是否以同样的方式行事。

blocks.en: In the 1,398-weight edit, 888 weights (64%) fall in four input columns of linear_attn.out_proj in layers 0–2. Each column is how one channel of one value head writes into the residual stream. They are the most constant channels in their layers, measured on 19 thinking traces with the base weights (Table 3 ). The smaller edits use the same channels: 113 of the 140 weights and 380 of the 500 sit in these four columns.
blocks.zh: 在1,398个重的编辑中,有888个重(64%)在4个输入列中倒入了线性-atn.out_proj分层为0–2. 每个栏目都是一个值头的通道如何向后流写入. 它们是其地层中最恒定的通道,以19个有底重的思维痕迹来衡量(表3)。 较小的编辑使用同道:这四列中,140个重的有113个,500个重的有380个.

blocks.en: Table 3: The four channels the 1,398-weight edit concentrates on: activation statistics under the base weights. “Layer median” is the median | mean | / std |\text{mean}|/\text{std} over the layer’s 2,048 channels.

blocks.en: Training only these four columns works as well as the full edit, and four random columns do not (Table 4 ). The parts of the 1,398-weight edit do not add up: each alone closes about 65 answers, together 342. The push seems to work only above a threshold. The four channels are not the whole edit: its 510 weights outside them score higher alone (about 33%) than the 888 inside them (about 25%).
blocks.zh: 只有这4个栏目以及全部编辑都有效,4个随机列不起作用(表4)。 1,398个重量的编辑部分不相加:每个部分单独关闭大约65个答案,共342. 推力似乎只能超过一个门槛。 这四个频道不是整个编辑:它以外的510个重分单得分(约33%)高于其中的888个重分(约25%).

blocks.en: This explains why the gradient picks these channels. The training signal asks for the same shift everywhere: finish sooner. Without biases, the cheapest way to add a constant is through a channel that is already constant. Placement matters, though: writing b 0 + b 1 + b 2 b_{0}+b_{1}+b_{2} into the layer-0 column alone fails (20.8%), although per-layer placement works.
blocks.zh: 这解释了梯度选择这些通道的原因. 训练信号要求各地实行同班制:提前完成. 没有偏见,增加常数的最便宜的方法就是通过一个已经是常数的通道. 但安置事项:写作b 0 + b 1 + b (韩语) 2 b_{0}+b_{1}+b_{2}入地层-0栏单行失败(20.8%),不过每层布置工作.

blocks.en: The edit does not simply raise the probability of </think> everywhere. On the base model’s looping traces, the edited model’s mean log-probability of </think> is lower than the base model’s ( − 29.7 -29.7 against − 26.9 -26.9 ), but its highest value per trace is higher ( − 5.8 -5.8 against − 8.0 -8.0 ). On the edited model’s own finished traces, the base model would also close at the same position: median log-probability − 0.13 -0.13 , above probability 0.5 in 94% of traces. The base model recognises when it is done. What it fails to do is reach that point, and the edit changes the path taken before it.
blocks.zh: 编辑并不简单地提高各地的 " /想 " 概率。 在基站模型的回转痕迹上,被编辑模型的" </想"的平均对数概率低于基站模型的(−29.7-29.7对−26.9-26.9),但其每回转痕迹的最高值较高(−5.8-5.8对−8.0-8.0). 在编辑过的模型本身的成品痕迹上,基模也会在同一位置关闭:中位对数概率−0.13-0.13,高于94%的痕迹中概率为0.5. 基础模型在完成时会识别出来。 它未能做到的是达到这个点,编辑会改变它之前所走的路径.

blocks.en: 5 Comparison with the GPT-6 Astra edit
blocks.zh: 5 与 GPT-6 Astra 编辑比较

blocks.en: The Astra edit is a different, input-dependent change in the middle of the network. At our 4k–8k budgets it rarely ends the loops, and stacking it on our edit adds nothing there. Section 6 shows that this changes at their 32k budget.
blocks.zh: Astra编辑是网络中间一个不同的,依赖输入的改变. 我们4k-8k的预算很少结束循环, 第6节显示,这种变化是在32克预算中发生的。

blocks.en: Only two tensors of the public checkpoint [ 2 ] differ from the base model: mlp.down_proj in layers 15 and 19. In each, 64 columns change, and the change has rank one: one direction u u carries all of it (fit residual 0.2–0.3%). On those columns, W ′ = W − 6 ​ u ​ u ⊤ ​ W . W^{\prime}=W-6\,uu^{\top}W. (2) This multiplies the component along u u that these 64 neurons write by − 5 -5 : the signal is flipped and amplified, not removed. Both layers use the same direction up to sign ( | cos | = 0.85 |\cos|=0.85 ).
blocks.zh: 公共检查站只有2个10分机[2]与基准模式不同:mlp.down_proj分层为15和19. 每列64个栏的变化,变化有一级:一个方向u u 携带全部(fit rest 0.2-0.3%). 在这些栏目上,W ' = W - 6 u = W。 (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). W^{\prime}=W-6\,uu^{\top}W. (2)这个将这64个神经元所写到的u-的元件相乘:信号被翻转并放大,而不是去除. 两层都使用相同的上行方向来签名(QQ Cos = 0.85 = 0.85 = 0.85).

blocks.en: Table 5 summarises the two edits. They point in nearly orthogonal directions. The vectors written by the four columns of our 1,398-weight edit have | cos | |\cos| with u u of at most 0.02, 0.03 and 0.05 for three columns. The fourth, in layer 2, reaches 0.10, above the 0.08 that random directions reach at the 99th percentile, so the overlap is small but not zero: 1% of that vector’s squared length lies along u u . Their edit tracks the loops. The amount the 64 neurons write along u u varies with position (mean/std 0.93 in layer 15, 0.76 in layer 19), and is 40–56% larger on looping traces than on finished ones (0.098 against 0.063 in layer 15; 0.129 against 0.091 in layer 19). Our edit does not act through their direction: on looping traces it leaves the residual stream’s cosine with u u almost unchanged (0.206 against 0.214 at layer 15, 0.251 against 0.244 at layer 19), while the Astra edit lowers it to 0.065 and 0.099.
Table 5: The two edits side by side.
blocks.zh: 表5:两地并列编辑.

blocks.en: Table 6 runs the public Astra checkpoint through our evaluation. Stacking the Astra edit on our 1,398-weight edit gives 43.8% and 40.4%, against 41.0% and 44.8% for ours alone. Their edit does close more code answers than the base model (105 against 61), where ours closes fewer.
blocks.zh: 表6通过我们的评估管理公共Astra检查站。 将 Astra 的编辑重排在我们1,398个重量的编辑上, 给出43.8%和40.4%, 而仅我们41.0%和44.8%。 他们的编辑确实关闭了比基础模型(105对61)更多的代码解答,因为我们的关闭更少.

blocks.en: Table 6: The public Astra checkpoint and our 139,750-weight edit under our protocol (no presence penalty, 4k or 8k tokens).
blocks.zh: 表6:公共Astra检查站和我们根据协议进行的139 750克重的编辑(无在场处罚,4k或8k令牌)。

blocks.en: This is not their protocol, which uses 32,768 tokens and presence penalty 1.5. We run it next.
blocks.zh: 这不是他们的协议,它使用32,768个代币和出庭处罚1.5。 接下来我们运行它。

blocks.zh: 6个 根据Astra协议:每个编辑在自己的制度下获胜,他们一起获胜

Any correct : the last boxed answer is correct, finished or not. We list the Astra report’s accuracy under any correct . Weights edited counts positions; the 139,750-weight edit and the Astra edit share 58, so together they edit 131,072 + 139,750 − 58 = 270,764 131{,}072+139{,}750-58=270{,}764 .

blocks.en: Our run of the public Astra checkpoint scores 55.7% (any correct), with 32.0% of answers hitting the limit, against 51.0% and 31.6% in their re-run (Table 7 ). Its strict score is 52.1%. Under this protocol the Astra edit beats each of our edits alone, by 5–6 points.
blocks.zh: 我们的公共Astra检查站的评分为55.7%(完全正确),32.0%的答案达到了极限,而51.0%和31.6%的复发率(表7)。 其严格分数为52.1%. 在此协议下, Astra 编辑会单独击败每个编辑, 5–6 分 。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Strict MATH-500 accuracy against token budget, Astra protocol. Points below 32k are read off the 32k answers (Section 2 ). Our edit is close to its best by 4k; the Astra edit needs about 20k tokens per answer to pass it. The combined edit is best at 16k and 32k; with our edit at full strength it is best at 8k and below.
blocks.zh: 图2:对照符号预算,Astra协议,严格MATH-500精确度. 32克以下的点读取32克的答案(第2节)。 我们的编辑工作以4k的速度接近其最佳水平;Astra的编辑每个回答需要约20k个符号才能通过. 合并编辑的最好为16k和32k;随着我们以全能编辑的最好为8k和以下.

blocks.en: Our edits finish early: half of our 1,398-weight edit’s answers use under 1,200 tokens, and its score at 4k (39.5%) is within 7 points of its score at 32k. The Astra edit thinks long. Its median answer uses 23,000 tokens, and it scores 6.7% at 4k and 27.5% at 16k. Ours is better at every budget up to 16k; the Astra edit passes it between 16k and 32k (Figure 2 ). The two edits fail in opposite ways. When the Astra edit closes its thinking, it is right 76.8% of the time, but only 67.8% of its answers close; most of the rest run out of tokens. Our 1,398-weight edit closes 87.6% of its answers but is right on only 52.2% of those.
blocks.zh: 我们的编辑提前完成:我们1 398个重量编辑的回答有一半在1 200个信使下使用,其4k(39.5%)的分数在32克的7分以内。 Astra的编辑认为很长。 它的中位数答案使用2.3万个令牌,以4k分得6.7%分,以16k分得27.5%分. Astra的编辑在16克到32克之间通过(图2)。 两种编辑方式以相反的方式失败. 当"Astra"编辑结束其思考时,时间的76.8%是正确的,但只有67.8%的答案关闭了;其余大部分都耗尽了道具. 我们的1 398个重量的编辑关闭了87.6%的答案,但只有52.2%的答案是正确的。

blocks.en: Adding our 139,750-weight edit to the Astra edit at full strength fixes the running out (0.5% hit the limit) but undoes the long thinking: the median answer falls to 1,068 tokens, and the score to 49.7%. At half strength, the combined model keeps most of the long thinking and loses most of the running out: 91.8% of answers close, and 67.8% of those are right. It scores 62.2% at 32k, 10.1 points above the Astra edit (better on 135 problems, worse on 54, p = 3 × 10 − 9 p=3\times 10^{-9} ), with 11,523 tokens per answer against 21,966. Our half-strength edit on its own scores 46.7% and runs out of tokens 42.9% of the time, so the gain needs both edits ( p = 2 × 10 − 19 p=2\times 10^{-19} against it). The combination is also best at 16k (54.0% against 27.5% for the Astra edit); at 8k and below, the full-strength combination is best (43.6% at 4k). One plausible reading: the Astra edit improves how the model reasons, and a weakened version of our constant push makes it stop once it is done.
blocks.zh: 将我们139 750 个重的编辑加入到 Astra 的编辑中, 以一半的实力,综合模型保持了大部分长时间的思考,并损失了大部分跑出:91.8%的答案接近,67.8%的答案是正确的. 它在32k,10.1分上方的Astra编辑得分62.2%(在135个问题上表现得更好,在54个问题上表现得更糟糕,p=3×10-9 p=3\times 10×9}),每个回答11,523个令牌对21,966个. 我们的半强编辑本身的分数是46. 7%, 超过42. 组合最好在16k(54.0%对27.5%的Astra编辑);在8k和以下,全能组合最好(43.6%为4k)。 一个有道理的解读:Astra的编辑改进了模型的原因,一个被削弱的版本的常推使得它一旦完成就停止了.

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: Takehi et al. [ 1 ] have a frontier model read and rewrite network weights without gradients, and stop Qwen3.5-0.8B’s loops with a 131,072-weight edit. Hu et al. [ 3 ] study the approach across 16 editing runs and two model sizes, including a 1,023-parameter edit worth 29.45 MATH-500 points. Neither compares against gradient-chosen sparse edits or random-position controls, which is our focus, and neither combines a model-written edit with a gradient edit.
blocks.zh: Takehi等编. [1] 有边框模型读取并重写网络重量而无梯度,并用131,072重的编辑停止了Quen3.5-0.8B的回路. 胡等编. [3] 研究16个编辑跑道和两个模型尺寸的方法,包括价值29.45 MATH-500分的1,023参数编辑. 既不与梯度选择的稀有编辑或随机位置控件相比,后者是我们的焦点,也不将模型写编辑与梯度编辑相结合.

blocks.en: ThinkEdit [ 7 ] finds a linear direction for reasoning length and edits the output projections of about 4% of attention heads (0.2% of parameters) to fix reasoning that is too short. Sheng et al. [ 8 ] find a direction, set before generation, whose strength controls reasoning length and shifts the probability of </think> . Our edit addresses the opposite problem, reasoning that never ends. It is found by gradient descent rather than by contrasting activations, and its four-column core amounts to a constant steering vector stored in the weights.
blocks.zh: ThinkEdit [7] 找到推理长度的线性方向,并编辑大约4%的注意力头(0.2%的参数)的输出预测,以固定太短的推理. 盛等编. [8] 找到一个方向,设定在世代之前,其强度控制了推理长度并改变了"/想"的概率. 我们的编辑解决了相反的问题,推理是永无止境的. 它通过梯度回落而不是通过对比活化而得到,它的四柱核相当于常向向量被存储在重量中.

blocks.en: Pipis et al. [ 5 ] attribute looping to errors in learning, which higher temperature only partly hides. Final Token Preference Optimization [ 6 ] trains against the first token of a loop, cutting greedy looping in Qwen3.5-4B from 22.9% to 1%.
blocks.zh: 皮皮斯等编. [5] 将循环归因于学习中的错误,而高温只能部分地隐藏. 最终Token优先优化[6]列车对接一环首个标志,将Quen3.5-4B中贪婪的环从22.9%削减到1%.

blocks.en: Choosing the k k parameters with the largest importance score and training only those is the FISH mask [ 9 ] , which uses Fisher information; we use summed absolute gradients. Mukherjee et al. [ 10 ] show that reinforcement learning updates only 5–30% of an LLM’s parameters, and that training that subnetwork alone recovers the result.
blocks.zh: 选择最重要分数的 k 参数, Mukherjee等 (英语). [10] 显示强化学习只更新了一个LLM参数的5-30%,而单是子网络的培训就能恢复结果.

blocks.en: Shao et al. [ 11 ] report that reinforcement learning with random rewards raises Qwen2.5-Math-7B on MATH-500 by 21.4 points, close to the 29.1 from true rewards, by amplifying behaviour learned in pretraining. Our result is another large benchmark jump that unlocks existing ability rather than adding new ability.
blocks.zh: 绍等. [11]报告,通过扩展在预训中学到的行为,通过随机奖励的强化学习,将MATH-500上的Quen2.5-Math-7B提升了21.4分,接近29.1分的真正奖励. 我们的结果是又一个大的基准跳出,解锁了现有的能力,而不是增加了新的能力.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: All results are for one model, Qwen3.5-0.8B, trained on MATH problems; we have not tested other sizes, other model families, or models with bias terms, where the constant-channel route may not be needed. Thinking-on results use two seeds, and dense LoRA and the 13,975-weight edit were each trained once. Under the Astra protocol we use two samples per problem rather than four, and test only MATH-500. We chose the strength of our edit in the combination from three values (1, 0.5, 0.25) on MATH-500 itself, with no held-out set; both weaker strengths beat the Astra edit by at least 7.7 points ( p ≤ 10 − 8 p\leq 10^{-8} ), so the gain does not hinge on one setting, but the 62.2% figure is the best of three. We did not test combinations with our smaller edits at reduced strength, or other benchmarks at 32k. The bias test covers the four-column edit, on 38 teacher-forced traces and 96 sampled problems, with a different inference engine (Hugging Face rather than vLLM); we have not tested whether the parts of our gradient edits outside the four channels act as constant vectors too. Packing the vectors into one column failed, and we do not know exactly why per-layer placement matters. Random positions were tested only at 1,398 and 139,750 weights. The 50- and 500-example runs drew from a pool made in 57.6 A100-minutes, and we did not measure the cost of generating 50 examples directly. Except at the 8k budget, the edits make thinking mode roughly as good as thinking off. On code they do not help and may slightly hurt (HumanEval with thinking off: 34.1% to 29.3%, p = 0.15 p=0.15 ). The whole project, including unrelated and failed runs, used about $49 of cloud compute: about $30 for the main study and $19 for the Astra-protocol runs. Some planned runs (edits of 50 and 14 weights, scaled one-column edits) stopped when the first $30 of credit ran out.
blocks.zh: 所有结果都针对一个模型, Quen3.5-0.8B, 训练有素的MATH问题; 我们没有测试其他大小, 其他模型家庭, 或带有偏差条件的模型, 在那里可能不需要常道路线. 思考结果使用两个种子,密集的LORA和13,975个重量的编辑每集训练一次. 根据Astra协议,我们每个问题使用两个样本而不是四个样本,只测试MATH-500. 我们从MATH-500本身的三个值(1, 0. 5, 0. 25)中选择了我们编辑的强度, 没有设置; 两个较弱的优势至少比 Astra 编辑的分数多出7.7分( 第 10 — 8 p\leq 10 — 8 ) , 因此收益并不取决于一个设定, 但62.2%的数字是三个中最好的。 我们没有测试结合 我们较小的编辑 以降低强度, 或其他基准 在32k。 偏差测试覆盖了四栏编辑,在38个由教师强制的痕迹上和96个抽样问题上,具有不同的推论引擎(Hugging Face 而不是vLLM);我们还没有测试我们的梯度编辑部分在四道之外是否也起到常量向量的作用. 把矢量放入一列失败了,我们不知道为什么每个层的放置都很重要。 随机位置的测试只有1 398和139 750个重量。 50和500个例子从57.6 A100分钟的游泳池中抽取,我们没有直接衡量产生50个例子的成本。 除了8k的预算,编辑使思维模式大致和思考关闭一样好. 在代码上,它们无济于事,可能稍有伤害(HumanEval的思考:34.1%到29.3%,p=0.15 p=0.15 ) 。 整个项目,包括无关和失败的运行,使用了约49美元的云计算:主研究约30美元,Astra-protocol运行约19美元。 一些计划运行(编辑为50分和14分重,缩放为一栏编辑)在信贷前30分耗尽后停止.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: A weight edit that takes a small model’s thinking-mode math score from 15% to 40–45% does not need a frontier model. Plain gradient descent finds one in minutes, from 50 of the model’s own answers, using as few as 140 weights. The edit stops the loops rather than adding skill. In this bias-free model, its core is a constant vector written through the most constant channels of the first three layers.
blocks.zh: 量子编辑需要一个小模型的思维模式数学分数从15%到40-45%不等,并不需要前沿模型。 平地梯度下降在分钟内发现一个,从模型本身的50个答案,使用多达140个重量. 编辑时会停止循环而不是添加技能. 在这个没有偏差的模型中,它的核心是一个通过前三层最恒定的通道所写的常向量.

blocks.en: The frontier model’s edit does something ours does not: given 32k tokens, it reasons better, and it beats our edits by 5–6 points. But it needs those tokens, and below 16k our edits win by large margins. The two edits are not rivals. Added together, with ours at half strength, they reach 62.2%, 10 points above the Astra edit and 15 above ours, with half the Astra edit’s tokens. Weight edits found in different ways can be stacked, and the best result here came from a frontier model’s edit and a gradient edit together. Claims about either should be measured against the other, at more than one token budget, with random-position controls and the thinking-off score reported alongside.
blocks.zh: 边疆模式的编辑做一些我们没有做的事:给32克的符号, 但它需要这些标志, 而16克以下 我们的编辑赢得了很大的边际。 两部编辑不相敌. 加上我们一半的力量,它们就达到了62.2%,超过Astra编辑的10分,超过我们的15分,还有一半Astra编辑的标志。 以不同方式发现的重量编辑可以被堆叠起来,这里最好的结果是边框模型的编辑和梯度编辑一起产生. 任何一项索赔均应在不止一项象征性预算中与另一项索赔相提并论,同时报告随机位置控制和反省分数。
